title: Sintel — Cave conversation
adaptation: Excerpt, extracted stills and stereo audio downmix; original dialogue timing retained. Shot detection threshold 0.06; no generated voices.

shots.heading: Blade and fire
shots.description: Detail of the blade held above the fire; a warm, shallow-focus introduction.

shots.heading: Shaman examines the blade
shots.description: Medium view of the shaman holding the blade diagonally, examining its history.

shots.heading: Over Sintel’s shoulder
shots.description: Reverse angle past Sintel toward the shaman and the fire between them.

shots.heading: Sintel reacts
shots.description: Close-up of Sintel listening, guarded and tired.

shots.heading: The shaman offers a bowl
shots.description: Over Sintel’s shoulder as the shaman reaches down with a bowl.

shots.heading: Sintel accepts the bowl
shots.description: Medium close-up; Sintel reaches out and offers a restrained thanks.

shots.heading: Wide conversation
shots.description: Wide view of both seated figures and the fire, establishing the shelter.

shots.heading: Sintel searches for words
shots.description: Close-up of Sintel, her attention lowered toward the bowl.

shots.heading: Bowl reflection
shots.description: Insert of the bowl in Sintel’s hands, her face reflected in its surface.

shots.heading: Shaman’s warning
shots.description: Close-up of the shaman as he speaks about the danger of her quest.

shots.heading: Sintel remembers
shots.description: Close-up of Sintel remembering, before the camera tilts away from her face.

shots.heading: Leaving the cave
shots.description: The camera has tilted away from Sintel; the shelter falls into darkness before the flashback.

shots.heading: City flashback
shots.description: The city emerges from darkness beneath the continuing cave conversation.

captionTiming.basis: Seconds relative to the extracted 106.5-second source start; local faster-whisper word alignment checked against centre-channel silence boundaries. Original subtitle text retained.
